svg.title: HerdBench: crowd signals, fact-checked
svg.desc: A tapestry of the real net positioning of the crowd, without market makers, in 30 markets on 305 snapshot dates from 28 Aug 2025 to 18 Aug 2026, none from 25 Oct 2025 to 14 Dec 2025: blue where traders held more longs, red where they held more shorts. Beside it: HerdBench, crowd signals fact-checked; 2 of 7 signals passed.
